abilities.name: Purge
abilities.text:
When used on an allied Hero, make them Unstoppable for 0.5 seconds. When used on an enemy Hero, Slow them by 80%, decaying over 2 seconds.

Cannot be cast on yourself.

abilities.name: Chain Heal
abilities.text: Heal an ally with a wave of healing for 260 Health. The wave then bounces 2 times to nearby allies within 7 range, restoring 260 Health to them.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.text: Imbue an ally with lightning dealing 64 damage a second to nearby enemies. Each enemy hit restores 1 Mana to Rehgar. Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Earthbind Totem
abilities.text: Create a totem that Slows nearby enemies by 35%. The totem has 260 Health and lasts for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.text: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Ancestral Healing
abilities.text: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 Health.

1.name: Stormcaller
1.text:
Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%.

Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 200 times.

1.name: Colossal Totem
1.text:
Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.

Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

1.name: Feral Heart
1.text: Ghost Wolf's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 40% for the first second, then falls to 30%. Entering or exiting Ghost Wolf form grants 15 Armor for 1 second.

4.name: Earthliving Enchant
4.text: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 Health over 4 seconds.

4.name: Electric Charge
4.text:
The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.

While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

4.name: Healing Totem
4.text: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125 Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

7.name: Grounded Totem
7.text:
Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.

Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

7.name: Purification
7.text:
If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220.

Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330 damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds.

Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds.

7.name: Blood and Thunder
7.text: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 4% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

10.name: Ancestral Healing
10.text: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 Health.

10.name: Bloodlust
10.text: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

13.name: Tidal Waves
13.text: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

13.name: Earth Shield
13.text: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

13.name: Wellspring
13.text: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

16.name: Rising Storm
16.text:
Every time a Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.

Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

16.name: Earthgrasp Totem
16.text: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

16.name: Hunger of the Wolf
16.text: Ghost Wolf attacks against Heroes deal an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health and heal Rehgar for 6% of his maximum Health.

20.name: Farseer's Blessing
20.text: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590.

20.name: Gladiator's War Shout
20.text: Increase the duration and range of Bloodlust by 100%.

20.name: Elemental Conduit
20.text:
Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

20.name: Pit Fighter
20.text:
Gain 10% increased Attack Damage and 3 Spell Power. Each nearby ally Hero grants an additional stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks.

While at 2 or more stacks, Purge's cooldown refreshes 50% faster.
